messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: These symptoms include trouble sleeping.
These symptoms include trouble concentrating.
These symptoms include a slower heart rate.
These symptoms include having the urge to smoke.
These symptoms include feeling anxious, restless, depressed, angry, frustrated, or irritated.
These symptoms may occur with or without using medication such as bupropion.
Smoking cessation may also cause new or worsening mental health problems, such as depression.
Triplet: ["smoking cessation", "may cause", "new or worsening mental health problems"]

The relation 'may cause' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or treatment may lead to the outcome or complication specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'can cause': The subject entity may lead to or result in the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has treatment requirement': The medical condition specified by the subject requires the treatment or management approach specified by the object entity.
D. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'caused by': The subject condition is caused by the pathogen or factor specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
